![Uploading zenqor-web-card.svg…]()
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="820" height="220" viewBox="0 0 820 220" role="img" aria-label="zenqor-web — Official corporate website of Zenqor Technologies" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0B1220"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0F1B2D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1F6FEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2EA043"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.06"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="card"><rect x="1" y="1" width="818" height="218" rx="14"/></clipPath>
    <style>
      .t  { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
      .k  { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.4px; fill: #7D8FA9; font-weight: 600; }
      .h  { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; fill: #F0F6FC; }
      .d  { font-size: 15px; fill: #A9B7C9; }
      .m  { font-size: 13px; fill: #C9D4E3; }
      .l  { font-size: 13px; fill: #58A6FF; font-weight: 600; }
      .fade { opacity: 0; animation: in 0.9s ease-out forwards; }
      .f2 { animation-delay: 0.15s; } .f3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; } .f4 { animation-delay: 0.45s; }
      @keyframes in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
      .sweep { animation: sweep 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes sweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-820px); } 60%,100% { transform: translateX(820px); } }
      .pulse { animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#card)">
    <rect width="820" height="220" fill="url(#bg)"/>
    <!-- subtle grid -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.025">
      <path d="M0 55H820M0 110H820M0 165H820"/>
      <path d="M205 0V220M410 0V220M615 0V220"/>
    </g>
    <rect class="sweep" width="820" height="220" fill="url(#shine)"/>
    <rect width="820" height="4" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="1" y="1" width="818" height="218" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#1F2A3C" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- left: logo mark -->
  <g class="fade" transform="translate(40 58)">
    <rect width="72" height="72" rx="16" fill="url(#accent)"/>
    <text x="36" y="49" text-anchor="middle" class="t" font-size="38" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Z</text>
  </g>

  <!-- main text -->
  <g class="t">
    <text x="136" y="62" class="k fade">FEATURED PROJECT  ·  PUBLIC REPOSITORY</text>
    <text x="136" y="100" class="h fade f2">zenqor-web</text>
    <text x="136" y="128" class="d fade f3">Official corporate website of Zenqor Technologies — consulting,</text>
    <text x="136" y="148" class="d fade f3">licensing, compliance and digital systems for Malaysian businesses.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- meta row -->
  <g class="t fade f4" transform="translate(136 184)">
    <circle cx="6" cy="-4" r="6" fill="#E34C26"/>
    <text x="18" y="0" class="m">HTML</text>

    <circle cx="84" cy="-4" r="4" fill="#2EA043" class="pulse"/>
    <text x="96" y="0" class="m">Live in production</text>

    <text x="240" y="0" class="m" fill="#3D4B60">|</text>
    <text x="258" y="0" class="l">www.zenqor.com.my  →</text>
  </g>

  <!-- right: status pill -->
  <g class="t fade f2" transform="translate(664 44)">
    <rect width="120" height="28" rx="14" fill="#0D2A1A" stroke="#2EA043" stroke-opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="14" r="4" fill="#2EA043" class="pulse"/>
    <text x="30" y="18.5" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1.6" fill="#56D364">OPERATIONAL</text>
  </g>
</svg>
